entities.name: Lucie Smutná
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucie Smutná is a Czech female volleyball player, playing as a setter. She is part of the Czech Republic women's national volleyball team. On club level she plays for CSM Volei Alba Blaj since the summer of 2018.
